lines.text: The house of Jacob swears by the LORD's name but not in truth or righteousness.
The LORD foretold the former things long ago, and suddenly He acted and they came to pass.
The LORD knew His people were stubborn, with necks of iron and foreheads of silver.
The LORD said He would tell them new, hidden things, and called them a rebel from childhood.
For His own sake, the LORD delayed His wrath and refined His people in the furnace of affliction.
